### The Importance of “Being Still” Before God
Author: Sarah E. Frazer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-importance-of-being-still-before-god-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 46:10
Points:
- Stillness before God means stopping our frantic striving and remembering that we do not have to fix everything ourselves.
- Practicing stillness involves actively learning, praying, and reflecting on God's proven faithfulness in scripture.
- The titles used in the psalm reveal that God is both an invincible protector and a deeply personal refuge.
- Resting in God's sovereign care and love allows believers to experience peace even in unsettling circumstances.

### When the Ground Gives Way
Author: Marshall Segal
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/when-the-ground-gives-way
Passage: Psalm 46:1–2
Points:
- Severe trials and earthly upheavals expose human weakness and shatter the illusion of self-sufficiency.
- God makes His presence felt most powerfully in seasons of crisis, acting as our immediate refuge and help.
- Beyond offering security, the Lord satisfies the hearts of His people with an enduring river of joy.
- The call to be still rebukes our instinct to save ourselves and summons us to rest in His exaltation.
